senses.sense_definition: Based on shared membership in a linguistic family or common origin.

examples.text: Although they share some vocabulary, the two languages have no <w>genetic</w> relationship.

target_lang_translations.ru: Хотя у них есть общая лексика, эти два языка не имеют <w>генетического</w> родства.

target_lang_translations.es: Aunque comparten algo de vocabulario, los dos idiomas no tienen ninguna relación <w>genética</w>.
target_lang_translations.zh: 尽管它们共享一些词汇，但这两种语言之间并没有<w>发生学</w>上的联系。

examples.text: Linguists use comparative methods to establish the <w>genetic</w> classification of dialects.
